name: Chatpata Khakhra Spicy Wheat Crisps
ingredients_raw: Whole Wheat Flour (78%), Refined Palmolein Oil (16%), Seasoning (4%) (Ground Spices and Condiments: Cumin Powder, Coriander Seeds, Rock Salt, Black Salt, Pomegranate Powder, Cilantro, Asafoetida, Turmeric Powder, Dry Ginger, Dry Mango, Cinnamon, Clove), Iodised Salt (2%).
